svg.title: Capillary grid refinement: fixed C100 estimators

cc:Work.dc:title: Capillary grid refinement: fixed C100 estimators
cc:Work.dc:description: Inferred C100 = (1 - T) rho100 / 2; signed percent error is 100 [C100 / ((0.8839 / 4)(1 - 15 epsilon)) - 1]. Panels show raw epsilon 0 and 0.0171 at physical h/W0 = 0.4, 0.6, 0.8. Colors/line styles distinguish declared lattice phases 0 and h/2 on all axes; circle/square markers show the fixed primary quintic6/quintic8 estimates. Whiskers span all four registered crossing-policy variants at the SAME geometry degree: quintic, cubic, raw, quinticAllAxes. They are policy sensitivity spans, not confidence intervals or certified error bounds. Connecting segments only join registered samples; no power law or physical coefficient is fitted. Degree4 estimates are retained in the exact CSV as lower-order geometry controls and do not enter the primary markers or whiskers. Every case is retained. Red rings/labels flag S: stationarity, R: resolution, C: centroid discrepancy; M marks missing primary or incomplete four-policy sensitivity. Missing primary values are marked at the axes footer, not at a fabricated data value, and incomplete sensitivity spans are not drawn. Windows, crossing policies, six-face combination and extrapolation remain those of the frozen replay. No capillary calibration or Q3 acceptance follows. Plot source SHA256: 9e0564527e301176881cf716945cf1c5434c551421fd4094bcc7da5717bb96f1
